qdrant.description: SHARED BRAIN — mcp-server-qdrant, dedicated 'thunderbird_memories_mcp' collection (2026-07-04: mcp-server-qdrant ONLY supports named vectors; the original 'thunderbird_memories' collection (4473 pts, written by core/memory/qdrant_memory.py) uses an unnamed vector and is architecturally incompatible with this MCP tool — every qdrant-find/qdrant-store call 400'd with 'Not existing vector name: fast-all-minilm-l6-v2'. Fixed by giving the MCP tool its own collection rather than risking/migrating the existing 4473 points. Same embedding model (384-dim all-MiniLM-L6-v2) so semantically compatible, just structurally separate. Mounted by BOTH CC and OC.
